caption.out: Colour shows the data on an asinh scale from 0 to 16383 DN per 4 × 4 binned pixel & "quoted" <text>. White is at 2625.5 DN per 4 × 4 binned pixel & "quoted" <text> (the 99th percentile of the unmasked pixels). In the HDR version, values above it are brighter, up to 4 × white at the top of the range; in the ordinary version they are white. The white level was set from a percentile of this image, so the figure is exploratory. 198 invalid or saturated pixels are held at or below white. Values above white are shown brighter only where they fill a 3 × 3 block of pixels; 1797 isolated pixels above it are held at white. Stated uncertainty: poisson, parameter 0.25. Rounding to this file's levels is up to 0.0015 of the stated uncertainty (a data record needs 0.1 or less). This file is a rendering, not a data record: one stored level spans up to 189.701 DN per 4 × 4 binned pixel & "quoted" <text>.
caption.note: numbers to 6 significant figures (the rounding ratio to 2), written out in full between 0.001 and 10000000, with U+2212 for a minus sign
